From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>

Subject: RE: Azure private plan: entitlement path & commercial commitments (internal)

Marissa / Laura —

I reviewed the terms matrix and drafted a short set of redlines we should propose to Horizon to reduce legal churn:

- Billing: Accept quarterly invoicing / net-45 but require clause for invoice disputes to be raised within 45 days.
- Data residency: Add explicit statement that customer data stored in Azure will follow Horizon region rules (we will not transfer data outside region without notice).
- IP / Escrow: If Horizon insists on IP escrow, propose an alternative: extended warranty + source escrow only triggered by insolvency. Escrow is heavy for a SaaS inference runtime.
- SLA & Credits: Offer a 99.5% uptime SLA for Private Plan with service credits capped at 50% of monthly fees — this keeps exposure reasonable.
- Indemnity/Limitations: Keep our standard cap (fees paid in prior 12 months) and exclude consequential damages.

I've attached an editable matrix with suggested language in column comments. See: Azure_PrivPlan_Terms_Matrix.xlsx (internal).

Marissa — do you want me to send these redlines directly to Lucy or have you incorporate them into the SOW first? I'm happy either way; if procurement is on a tight timeline we can call out the top 3 items in-line and leave more detailed language for the final SOW.

-David
David Kim
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attached is Horizon_SOW_v3.pdf (redline accepted items) and a fresh Terms Matrix (the comments are included).

To your specific asks:
- Co-sell contact: Vanessa Ortiz (vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com) will be listed as the commercial co-sell lead for Azure intake. We typically propose a 15% revenue share for co-sell motions on partner-led marketplace deals; happy to confirm with our partnerships team if Horizon has a different expectation.
- Invoice routing: We will route invoices to procurement@horizonfin.com. Please confirm the full invoice mailing address and remit-to tax ID so we can populate the SOW.
- IP escrow: As David suggested, Redwood prefers source escrow only in constrained circumstances; if Horizon needs escrow language we can provide a conditional escrow clause (triggered by bankruptcy/insolvency).
- Term & termination: Proposed 12-month term with 60-day termination-for-convenience notice (prorated final invoice).

DocuSign: I can send the SOW via DocuSign once you confirm invoice routing and the revenue-share decision.
